title: A Quo Omarchy plugin update delta candidate v1

providers.x-a-quo-order: strictly ascending provider_id; sorted union of previous and current provider bindings; ghost provider deltas forbidden by cross-record validation

fileDelta.x-a-quo-semantic: change tag is recomputed from previous/current content digest and mode

capability_changes.x-a-quo-semantic: must remain empty; Stage 0 rejects capability deltas until the Stage-2 provider-envelope parser and identity projection can derive them

coverage_regressions.x-a-quo-semantic: must remain empty; Stage 0 rejects coverage deltas until the Stage-2 provider-envelope parser and identity projection can derive them

providerDelta.x-a-quo-semantic: previous/current envelope digests are nullable but at least one must be present and each must exactly match the corresponding retained provider binding when present; every retained old or current provider binding has one provider delta; a provider ID absent from both binding lists is invalid during cross-record validation; Stage-0 provider deltas carry no provider-version, component, scanner, ruleset, or other identity fields beyond provider_id; new limitation/error IDs require a current envelope; comparability remains unavailable and comparison claims remain empty until Stage 2 defines the provider-envelope parser and identity projection

x-a-quo-semantic: plugin_id has only unchanged/changed states and version has only upgrade/equal/downgrade states; both are derived from the two valid manifest subjects. SemVer comparison uses precedence and ignores build metadata. publisher_continuity is derived from the two publisher-evidence records. Exact file deltas, permission_expansion, and fresh_consent_required are recomputed; old/new evidence digests and previous/current envelope bindings are cross-checked. The provider-delta union is capped at 32 entries. At Stage 0 permission_expansion is false because capability_changes is empty; any provider delta still makes fresh_consent_required true
